learning_outcomes.text: Learns basic concepts related to culture and civilization.
Comprehends the elements that constitute Turkish Culture.
Comprehends the historical development and change of Turkish Culture.
Evaluates the place and importance of Turkish Culture within world cultures.
Evaluates the current effects of art, language, and religion in Turkish people.

syllabus_topics: Main characteristics of Turkish culture and civilization
Historical change and development of Turkish culture
Stage and spectacular plays in Turkish culture, Short quiz
Economic and social life in Turkish culture
Imaret, waqf, Ahi tradition in Turkish culture
Impact of Turkish culture on world culture and its place and importance within the family of cultures
